meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发前的调研与访谈整理成可直接执行的编码方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到编程任务时希望先彻底理清需求再动手写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn pre-coding research into an executable development plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, approved plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以规划顾问 Prometheus 身份工作:先只读探索代码库,只问必须你拍板的问题;未经你明确同意绝不开始实现,同意后产出一份决策完整的工作计划,后续执行无需再向你追问。
howto.when: 仅当你明确要求进入该工作流时触发——例如直接说"ulw-plan""ulw plan",或用自己的话要求"先做个计划";普通任务不会自动激活,计划模式会一直保持到拿到你的批准。

say.text: 请用 ulw-plan 把这次改动拆成一份执行计划
say.note: Claude 进入规划模式,先探索,不直接改代码。

say.text: ulw-plan,先探索代码,等我确认后再写计划
say.note: 未经确认不会动工,只产计划。

say.text: 帮我 plan this,给一份决策完整的方案
say.note: 会覆盖整个请求,产出可执行计划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes Prometheus, a planning consultant. It explores read-only, asks only what really needs your call, never implements before your explicit OK, and outputs one decision-complete plan an executor can run with zero follow-up.
howto.when_en: Activates only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow, such as saying 'ulw-plan', 'ulw plan', or asking for a work plan before coding. It never self-activates; plan mode stays until you approve.

say_en.text: Please use ulw-plan to break this change into an execution plan.
say_en.note: Claude enters planning mode, explores first, and won't edit code.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: explore first, wait for my OK before writing the plan.
say_en.note: Stays in planning-only mode until you approve.

say_en.text: Help me plan this; give me a decision-complete plan.
say_en.note: Covers the whole request and outputs an executable plan.
